name: Oasive
long_description: Oasive gives bond investors the data, models and research to decide what to buy. For muni credit analysts, Oasive brings a borrower's audited financials, debt, board meetings and local news into one page built around what matters for that sector, with every number linked to its source. Before a fund buys a bond from a city, school district, hospital or airport, that's the information its analyst has to dig up by hand from PDFs on local websites, board minutes and local news. We also serve agency MBS investors (collateral analytics, our own prepayment model and loan-level relative value) and rates investors (US and global macro with Treasury rich/cheap models).
one_liner: Credit research for municipal bond analysts
